definitions.gloss: to put to use, to make use of
definitions.explanation: To utilize something effectively for a particular purpose. Implies actively making something serve a useful function.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{役立|やくだ}てる。
examples.english: To put one's experience to use.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{役立|やくだ}て→役立つ：03168_yakudatsu⟧たい。
examples.english: I want to put what I learned while studying abroad to use in my work.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{役立|やくだ}てること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can put the knowledge from this book to use in everyday life.

notes:
USAGE:
{役立|やくだ}てる is transitive — someone actively puts something to use. Compare with the intransitive ⟦{役立|やくだ}つ→役立つ：03168_yakudatsu⟧, which means something is useful on its own. {役立|やくだ}てる emphasizes the agent's intentional use of a resource.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{役立|やくだ}てる: to put experience to use
- ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{役立|やくだ}てる: to put knowledge to use
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{役立|やくだ}てる: to put to use in one's work
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{役立|やくだ}てる: to put to use for society
